description: This file defines utility methods for byte array operations in Apache Spark, including array equality checks, pattern matching, and byte size calculations.

classes.name: ByteArrayMethods
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for byte array manipulation and comparison in Spark.

methods.name: nextPowerOf2
methods.description: Returns the next power of two greater than or equal to the given number.

methods.name: roundNumberOfBytesToNearestWord
methods.description: Rounds the number of bytes to the nearest multiple of 8.

methods.name: arrayEquals
methods.description: Checks if two byte arrays are equal over a specified length, optimized for aligned and unaligned memory access.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a byte array contains a specific subarray.

methods.name: startsWith
methods.description: Checks if a byte array starts with a given target byte sequence.

methods.name: endsWith
methods.description: Checks if a byte array ends with a given target byte sequence.

methods.name: matchAt
methods.description: Checks if a subarray matches at a specific position within a byte array.
